tasks.title: LÖVE2D Configuration
tasks.description: Create conf.lua, the LÖVE2D configuration callback that sets window dimensions (1280×720), title ('Math Quest'), disables unused modules (joystick, physics), and enables audio. This runs before love.load and requires no other files.

tasks.title: Game Logic Module
tasks.description: Implement game.lua — the core module containing all game state, particle system, problem generation, input handling, scoring/lives, timer, audio loading/playback, and rendering for all three game states (title, playing, gameover). Loads correct.wav and wrong.ogg as static audio sources. The particle system is hand-rolled (no love.graphics.newParticleSystem). Problem generation scales arithmetic difficulty with score. Handles minus-key suppression in love.keypressed (noting the LÖVE2D return value caveat). Timer expiry auto-submits: empty buffer = wrong, non-empty buffer = evaluate normally. Exports Game table with load/update/draw/keypressed/textinput.

tasks.title: Main Entry Point
tasks.description: Create main.lua, which requires game.lua and wires all LÖVE2D callbacks (love.load, love.update, love.draw, love.keypressed, love.textinput) to the corresponding Game module functions. Contains no game logic of its own.
